description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao class responsible for data access operations related to US tax exemption information for employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save an employee's tax exemption data and retrieve it by employee number.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling database operations related to employee US tax exemption information.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Persists an EmpUsTaxExemption entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity based on the employee number.
